get_minibatch_blob_names: get the blob names for a Detectron network data loader in training or inference mode
get_minibatch: construct a minibatch of blobs sampled from a given roidb for RPN, RetinaNet, or Fast R-CNN
get_image_blob: build an input image blob from a roidb with random scale sampling and optional flipping
review_get_minibatch: review the get_minibatch function to understand how it dispatches between RPN, RetinaNet, and Fast R-CNN blob construction
summarize_minibatch_module: summarize the minibatch module which constructs training minibatches for Detectron object detection networks
